messages:
hana-hr: Quick coordination for Casey (remote). Need to pick I-9 path, confirm background check status, and confirm laptop shipping. Start date: Mon next week.
sara-recruiter: Casey prefers employer-authorized agent (kiosk) but is also open to mobile notary if kiosk isn't available. Casey, what's your zipcode so we can find nearby partners?
casey-newhire: Hi! Zip 98101. Kiosk sounds easier. Available Mon morning. Also please ship laptop to my temporary address: 12 Harbor Way, Unit 3.
quentin-it: Noted. Standard image -> 24h. If we need day-1 VPN, mark ticket as expedited. Also need to know if Casey wants a dock.
casey-newhire: No dock. VPN day-1 would be great for orientation.
bgcheck-bot: Checkr: background check submitted. Status: pending identity verification.
sara-recruiter: For identity mismatch watch: sometimes previous records use middle initial. Casey, please confirm any alternate names used on resume or past employment.
casey-newhire: I used my full middle name earlier (Casey Marie). That might be what triggered it. Happy to upload a scan if needed.
hana-hr: Good catch. Casey, please upload a photo ID + e-sign consent to the secure portal. If Checkr requests more, we'll escalate.
quentin-it: Creating ticket IT-7782 (tag: newhire-casey). I'll set expedited shipping and request VPN onboarding group on day 1 but HR must approve SSO group membership.
sara-recruiter: Benefits note: 30-day enrollment window from start date. We'll send BenAdmin email on day 1 but I'll attach a quick benefits snapshot now.
hana-hr: Day-1 run of show (draft): 09:30 intro; 10:00 benefits & payroll; 10:30 IT/MFA; 11:00 manager/team meet; 11:30 Q&A. Any additions?
quentin-it: Add a 10-min MFA break for authenticator setup. Ask Casey to have personal phone ready.
casey-newhire: Got it, phone ready. I uploaded ID and a note about my previous name.
bgcheck-bot: Checkr update: identity documents received. In progress.
hana-hr: Action items summary:
- sara-recruiter: attach benefits snapshot + confirm kiosk partner near 98101 (today)
- quentin-it: IT-7782 created, expedited imaging + request onboarding SSO (today)
- casey-newhire: uploaded ID and name note (done)
- hana-hr: send Day-1 invite with Zoom link and benefits packet (today)

sara-recruiter: Kiosk partner found at 5th & Main UPS Access Point, generating auth code and DMing Casey.
quentin-it: Laptop shipped express. Tracking UPS 1ZCASE... ETA Sun. Ticket moved to In Progress.
hana-hr: Thanks all. If Checkr hits any issues we will reconvene here. Closing loop unless anyone needs anything else. :thumbsup:
